title: velocity-reliability-map: analysis code and result tables for "A Reliability Map for Per-Gene Multiome RNA Velocity Parameters in Single-Cell Kinetics" (ML4H 2026)
description: Analysis scripts, per-gene result tables, MultiVelo refit tables, measured-rate reference tables, sealed preregistration and environment files for the ML4H 2026 Findings paper "A Reliability Map for Per-Gene Multiome RNA Velocity Parameters in Single-Cell Kinetics". Every number in the paper is produced by a script in this archive.
